name: shunge-xhs
description: Turns a topic into a publish-ready Xiaohongshu note: titles, body copy, cover plan, image prompts and a pre-publish check, with diagnosis of old notes and comment replies.

displayDescription.en: Turns a topic into a publish-ready Xiaohongshu note: titles, body copy, cover plan, image prompts and a pre-publish check, with diagnosis of old notes and comment replies.
displayDescription.zh: 从小红书选题、标题、正文、封面到发布前体检，按账号卡产出可直接发布的图文笔记，诊断旧笔记、回复评论。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 写一篇小红书笔记，先看我的账号卡。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Write a Xiaohongshu note; read my account card first.

quickPrompts.en: Write a Xiaohongshu note; read my account card first.

quickPrompts.en: This note underperformed; diagnose where it went wrong.
quickPrompts.zh: 这篇笔记数据差，帮我诊断问题出在哪。

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我回这几条评论，别太像客服。
